title: Paikaan Baras Rahey Hain Taboot Per Hasan Ke
body:
paikaan baras rahe hai taboot par hasan a.s ke.
Ummat mitaa rahi hai asaar panjetan ke.
1)zainab s.a pukaari rooke bhai dil doobta hai mera.
Ugloo na dil ke tukde sadqe gai dahen
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Zainab hai baal khoole ummat hai teer toole.
Poocho na shaam ki jab yeh haal hai watan ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
3) taboot se lipat kar qasim a.s pukaarey baba.
Nouhey aqii ke dekho dukhdey suno bahen ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
4) waapis kiya janaza farzand e mustafa a.s ka.
Ahsaan bhoola diye hai kyu waaris e zaman ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
5) zehra s.a ki aa rahi hai baqyaa se yeh sadaaye. Kyu phool noochte ho loogo mere chaman ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
6)ghaazi yeh keh rahe the yoo teer na chalaoo.
Tukde hazaar kardoo beshak mere badan ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
7)baba ke dil ke tukde tune chune bahattar.
Tukde hazaar honge qasim a.s tere badan ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
8)mayyat pe teer dekho roro pukaari zainab s.a
aisey naseeb hona yaarab kisi bahen ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
9) aise koi janaza waapas hua na loogo.
Palti hai jaise mayyat shabbar ki bin dafan ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
10)saayein me murtuza a.s ke bichde the fatema s.a se.
Aur aaj paas maa ke aaye hai laash ban ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
11)aaqhir ki hichkiyoo me shabbar ne rooke choome.
Shabbir a.s ka gala aur baazu badi bahen ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
12) boley hasan ke zainab s.a dil doobta hai mera.
Nazdeek aa gaye hai waade woh baal o pan ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
13) baitul nabi se haay uththa hai phir janaza.
Yarab ki bastiyoo me jakde hai phir dafan ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
14)na ban saka hasan a.s ka qoorbe nabi me madfan.
Raste me teer toole dushman khade hai tan ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
15)tan par hai tu hasan a.s ke gooh cheedh gaya hai saara.
Mohtaaj hi rahega shabbir a.s tu kafan ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
16)yasrab me karbala me baghdaad o saamera me.
Afsoos phool bikhre zehra s.a tere chaman ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
17)jal jayega bulaakar ghar fatema s.a ka saara.
Baazu tumharey hoonge bachoo me ek rasan ke.
<<DIVIDER>>
18)moula nisaar apni shamsheer kyun uthaaye.
Jab ke wo janasheen e paygambar e aman ke.
